items.question: How many paid annual leave days do full-time employees get per year?
items.reference: Full-time employees accrue 25 days of paid annual leave per calendar year.

items.question: How much annual leave can be carried over to the next year?
items.reference: Up to 5 days of unused annual leave may be carried into the following year; anything above 5 days is forfeited on 31 December.

items.question: When is a doctor's note required for sick leave?
items.reference: A doctor's note is required only for a sick absence longer than two consecutive working days.

items.question: How many paid sick days are employees entitled to each year?
items.reference: Employees are entitled to 10 paid sick days per year.

items.question: How many days a week can I work remotely without director approval?
items.reference: Employees may work remotely up to three days per week; four or more days requires written director approval.

items.question: Does ACME reimburse home internet costs for remote workers?
items.reference: No. The company does not reimburse home internet or electricity costs, but provides a one-time 300 dollar home-office equipment stipend.

items.question: What is the deadline for submitting an expense claim?
items.reference: Expense claims must be submitted within 60 days of the expense being incurred.

items.question: What expense amount requires director sign-off before it is incurred?
items.reference: Any single expense above 500 dollars requires director sign-off before the expense is incurred.

items.question: What is the international daily meal allowance when travelling?
items.reference: The daily meal allowance while travelling is 90 dollars international.

items.question: How often are company laptops refreshed?
items.reference: Laptops are refreshed every three years.

items.question: How quickly must lost or stolen equipment be reported?
items.reference: Lost or stolen equipment must be reported to IT Security within 24 hours.

items.question: What is the minimum password length on company laptops?
items.reference: Passwords must be at least 14 characters.

items.question: How long is the probation period for new employees?
items.reference: New employees serve a probation period of six months.

items.question: What is the notice period for a manager after probation?
items.reference: After probation the notice period is three months for managers.

items.question: In which months are performance reviews held?
items.reference: Performance reviews are held twice per year, in June and December.

items.question: What is the company's policy on cryptocurrency trading by employees?
items.reference: The handbook does not contain this information.

items.question: What health insurance provider does ACME use?
items.reference: The handbook does not contain this information.
